name: PDF Invoice For Woo Order
author: The iFlair Team

sections.description:
PDF Invoice For WooCommerce is a simple yet powerful plugin that allows you to create, customize, and manage PDF invoices for your WooCommerce store. With this plugin, you can add a watermark, include your logo image. Customers can also download their invoices from their My Account page.

Features

  • Basic Settings: Easily configure your PDF invoice settings.
  • Customize PDF with Watermark: Add a custom watermark to your invoices.
  • Add Logo Image: Personalize your invoices with your company logo.
  • Download Invoice: Customers can download their invoices directly from the My Account page.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce: WooCommerce plugin must be installed and active
sections.installation:
1. Upload Plugin: Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure Settings: Go to the WooCommerce settings and navigate to the ‘PDF Invoice’ tab to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the PDF template?

Yes, you can customize the template to match your branding.

How can I add a watermark to the invoices?

You can add a watermark in the plugin’s settings under the ‘Watermark’ section.

Can customers download their invoices?

Yes, customers can download their invoices from their My Account page.
